issues.title: Same-year Saab 9-5 US/CA ATF change milestone conflict
issues.cause: The 60k-mile factory US/CA checklist orders ATF service, while the separate annual extra-work list prints 70k miles/5 years.
issues.diagnosis_summary: Record original WIS edition, actual gearbox serial/code and printed owner booklet; request service receipts. Preserve both conditions without averaging.
issues.correction_summary: Do not authorize specific maintenance timing or ATF fluid by selecting a preferred row until the original edition is reconciled.
limits: Not evidence of mechanical gearbox damage
Do not replace a recorded discrepancy with an invented standard interval

issues.title: 2008 9-5 may be within two distinct historical safety campaigns
issues.cause: Original 16V063 driver inflator and 08V160 A-pillar trim campaigns identify model-year populations that include MY2008 9-5.
symptoms: No pre-failure symptom required for airbag inflator
No obvious visual clue confirms A-pillar trim campaign completion
issues.diagnosis_summary: Retrieve actual VIN, manufacturer recall file, prior recall invoice and competent dealer history; treat NHTSA VIN results for old cars as limited.
issues.correction_summary: Only qualified safety recall channel may confirm needed inflator/A-pillar remedy; do not dismantle SRS or purchase trim by year alone.
limits: Individual VIN participation and completion unknown
Historical free remedy does not certify 2026 shop stock

issues.title: 9-3 convertible seat belt recall cannot be generalized to 2005-06 sedans
issues.cause: Original GM 2014 driver retractor notice only covers Saab 9-3 convertibles; a different passenger-side programme was special coverage.
symptoms: Driver belt webbing can fail to retract properly
issues.diagnosis_summary: Verify 9-3 body-style/actual VIN and check past campaign 14222 completion with service provider.
issues.correction_summary: Confirm qualified driver-retractor recall repair where applicable; keep passenger coverage separate.
limits: Do not extend convertible-only recall to sedan
